children: According to Wallstreetcn, underwriters including Santander and Jefferies privately priced loans tied to the "Jupiter project" at 89-91 cents on the dollar, according to people familiar with the matter. Blue Owl declined to comment, while Santander, Jefferies, and STACK Infrastructure did not respond to requests for comment.

title: Santander, Jefferies Quote Jupiter Project Loan at 89-91 Cents on the Dollar
